name: Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon
short_description: A full-marathon event in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines, held on December 13, 2026, with distances from 5km to 42.195km.
ai_summary: The Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon is a full-marathon event scheduled for December 13, 2026, in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines.
